Its claims are exceptionally well-disciplined, negative and bounded results are prominently analyzed, and statistical adjustments are appropriately applied throughout.

evidence.excerpt:
Persistent memory can improve personalization in LLM agents
but can also induce sycophancy and cross-domain leakage. We dis-
tinguish two governance decisions:admission, which determines
what recalled information enters the working context, andpresenta-
tion, which determines how admitted information is expressed. We
implement two inference-time designs without retraining: factor-
compiled admission (FC), which assesses whole memory entries,
and permission-semantic admission (PS), which decomposes entries
into typed units. Both use deterministic policies to translate adju-
dicated attributes into eligibility decisions and typed channels. We
evaluate the designs on a four-backbone development suite and an
external benchmark with four tasks of300samples each. Relative to
verbatim injection, FC and PS reduce pooled judge-assessed failure
rates on the external benchmark by6.7and8

evidence.excerpt:
One batched adjudication call receives the query, the recent dia-
logue, benchmark-provided evidence, andall 𝑘 memories together,
and returns a structured verdict. Its design has three fixed properties,
shared across both admission designs and both evaluation surfaces:
(1) Attribute assessment separated from policy decisions.
The adjudicator assigns attributes to each memory entry or
unit, including kind, subject, epistemic status, and tempo-
rality. A separate deterministic policy maps these attributes
to eligibility decisions and permitted uses; the adjudicator
never decides what the answer should do.
(2) Situation awareness.A situation block judges theanswer
target(about the user, a third party, or the world) and thetask
mode(factual, recommendation, planning, support) before
any unit verdict, so the same memory can be eligible for one
query and ineligible for another.
(3) Physical

evidence.excerpt:
(the Presentation Lever)
Holding adjudicated verdicts and admitted content fixed, we com-
pare two renderings.PN (permission-note rendering): admitted
units are grouped under section headers, each stating what that
section's information may be used for in this answer.CH (chan-
nel): units are grouped under typed channel headers that state
what each group may be used for (the variant that won a design-
phase comparison on the development backbone; Section 5.3). Both
are sectioned renderings encoding the same permission semantics
over the same admitted units; they differ in section labeling and
organization—permission-note labels vs. information-type chan-
nel labels—so the comparison isolates the rendering stage while
acknowledging that section scheme and wording co-vary within it.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The development-surface judge was validated against an item-level adjudicated consensus of two independent human annotators on a stratified sample of 360 outputs, yielding binary kappa = 0.70 [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0031].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Headline outcomes are binary failure judgments from a distinct external judge (GLM-5.2) scoring benchmark tasks under fixed rubrics, with the judge never serving as a generator [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0030, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0031].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The adjudication schemas, deterministic compilation rules, and rendering assets were frozen before confirmatory data collection, with design-phase selection of the CH rendering occurring on a development backbone [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0022, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0026].

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims are carefully calibrated to experimental evidence, transparently acknowledging that the preregistered effect-size gate was missed, that memory–evidence conflict failures remain high (over 82%), and that admission incurs an overshoot cost in personalization failures [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0011, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0012, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0051].
primary.evaluation_assessment: Evaluation covers multiple generator backbones across development and external benchmarks, employing paired McNemar tests and appropriate multiple-comparison corrections (Benjamini–Hochberg and Holm) [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0030, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0032]. The experiments demonstrate statistically significant reductions in cross-domain leakage and external failure rates for admission pipelines, while confirming that alternative presentation renderings under fixed verdicts yield no robust differences [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0039, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0045].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Development-surface automated judge scores were verified against an item-level adjudicated consensus of two independent human annotators on a stratified sample of 360 outputs, finding binary Cohen's kappa = 0.70 [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0031].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Binary failure judgments on benchmark tasks scored by a distinct frozen external judge (GLM-5.2) under benchmark-standard rubrics [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0030, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0031].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Prompt-based situated adjudication schemas and deterministic compilation rules frozen prior to confirmatory evaluation runs [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0022, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0026].

primary.limitations: The authors document clear boundaries, including increased missed-personalization failures, lack of improvement on GPT-OSS-120B under tested configurations, failure to mitigate memory–evidence conflicts when conflicting memory is present, and reliance on an automated external judge with human validation limited to the development set [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0011, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0031, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0051, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0056].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, decomposing governance into situated adjudication via an LLM judge that extracts attributes without prescribing actions, followed by deterministic code mapping attributes to typed channels or permission-based denial [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0007, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0022, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0025]. The study uses preregistered protocols, frozen assets, shared ledgers for verdict-matched presentation isolation, and budget-matched controls [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0026, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0045].
primary.quality_rationale: This study provides a rigorous, preregistered experimental investigation that cleanly dissects admission from presentation in agent memory. Its claims are exceptionally well-disciplined, negative and bounded results are prominently analyzed, and statistical adjustments are appropriately applied throughout.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper distinguishes and experimentally isolates two levers in LLM agent memory governance—admission (what enters working context) and presentation (how admitted items are structured)—introducing situated adjudication mechanisms (factor-compiled and permission-semantic admission) evaluated across internal development and external benchmarks [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0002, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0007, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0008].

scholarly_quality.rationale: This study provides a rigorous, preregistered experimental investigation that cleanly dissects admission from presentation in agent memory. Its claims are exceptionally well-disciplined, negative and bounded results are prominently analyzed, and statistical adjustments are appropriately applied throughout.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors document clear boundaries, including increased missed-personalization failures, lack of improvement on GPT-OSS-120B under tested configurations, failure to mitigate memory–evidence conflicts when conflicting memory is present, and reliance on an automated external judge with human validation limited to the development set [E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0011, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0031, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0051, E9c43c60ccb5c03a1-B0056].

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.
